note: Seed for docs/index/GLOSSARY.md. `terms` is curated by hand: edit here, then run `npm run index`. `slices` is extracted from the F1 wiring spec, which is kept outside this repository; re-extract with `npx tsx scripts/index/generate.ts --refresh-glossary --spec <file> --ref icm/02-gap-matrix/output/F1/WIRING-SPEC.md`.

terms.definition: Lilly's frontend under `frontend/`. Authoritative for which screens, elements and data exist and how they look (source authority 0).
The root Next App Router app (`app/`, `lib/`, `components/`) that serves the canvas.
A `(name)` directory that adds no path segment; `app/(tracker)` holds the client-facing tracker shell.
Resolver that combines an `ENABLE_*` flag with a trusted `APP_ENV` classification, so an unset, invalid or conflicting flag fails closed in production.
Deny when configuration or state is missing, unknown or conflicting, instead of assuming the permissive case.
Exact per-domain consent check that has to pass before health data is read or written.
One resource/action/role cell of the authorization table. The guard re-reads current database state and never trusts token claims.
Audit event that carries ids and counts only, never values.
Per domain in `lib/`: `*-boundary.ts` validates the shape of input or stored payload, `*-gate.ts` decides runtime enablement.
One card and PR of the program plan. Slice ids are the vocabulary used across `icm/` (table below).
Spec that maps each canvas interaction onto the backend slices that deliver it; the source of the slice ids below.
Compare-and-set save on a draft: a stale tab receives a conflict instead of silently overwriting newer work.
A gap-matrix row parked pending an owner answer; tracked in `docs/open-questions.md` and answered in `icm/03-plan/OWNER-ANSWERS-1018.md`.
A client reads only their own records, staff read only assigned clients, owners read the workspace. Enforced server-side; UI hiding is not authorization.
The tenant boundary. Membership carries one of WORKSPACE_OWNER, COACH, ASSISTANT_COACH, SUPPORT, CLIENT.
Any change to what a screen shows needs before/after screenshots at 1440 and 390 px.
Only one task at a time edits `db/schema.prisma` and its migrations.
`docs/STATUS.md` holds the implementation state; ICM lanes and this index never write it.
Never implement client-visible or underivable behavior for these. No diagnoses and no automatic program changes.
